data.body: AC-AMENDMENT (gap-analysis): (1) Unassign failure: log warning + write second BRIDGE_ALERT with reason 'unassign failed for <key>: <error>'. (2) Only call unassign_issue when jira_key non-empty AND no account_id resolved. (3) _parse_user_map and _resolve_assignee must be module-level (not nested). (4) _resolve_assignee: normalize lookup-side via email.lower(). (5) AcliClient.unassign_issue docstring must document why direct REST is used instead of ACLI (body shape mismatch).
